## Goal

Add iterator versions of `MinMax` and `MinMaxBy` that consume an `iter.Seq` exactly once, preserve first-of-equals semantics, and include focused tests and examples for the iterator package.

## Plan

### Files to touch

- `it/find.go`
- `it/find_test.go`
- `it/find_example_test.go`

### Steps

1. Append exactly `func MinMax[T constraints.Ordered](collection iter.Seq[T]) (T, T)` and `func MinMaxBy[T any](collection iter.Seq[T], less func(a, b T) bool) (T, T)` to `it/find.go` after `SamplesBy`, in that order, without changing its import block or existing declarations. Range directly over the sequence, seed both results from its first item, update the minimum only when the item is strictly before it and the maximum only when the current maximum is strictly before the item, and return zero values for an empty sequence.
2. Add doc comments beginning with each function name that describe the single-pass behavior, empty-sequence result, comparison semantics and first-of-equals rule. Include `// Will iterate through the entire sequence.` in both comments and no `// Play:` line.
3. Add `TestMinMax` and `TestMinMaxBy` in `it/find_test.go`, using `t.Parallel()` and `assert.New(t)`, covering empty and singleton sequences, ordered and custom results, ties at both extremes, no comparator call for zero/one item, and a sequence yielding `4, 8, 1, 6` that proves one start, four yields, completion at the end, and result `1, 8`.
4. Insert `ExampleMinMax` and `ExampleMinMaxBy` immediately after `ExampleMaxIndexBy` in `it/find_example_test.go`, in that order, using the same inputs and output comments as the core examples wrapped in `slices.Values`, without variables named `min` or `max`.
5. Run `gofmt` on the changed iterator Go files and verify the repository with `go test ./...`; also perform the repository-wide formatting check required by acceptance criterion 20.

### Tests to add

- `TestMinMax` for empty, singleton, ordered, negative, string, duration, and tied sequence results, plus start/yield counts.
- `TestMinMaxBy` for length/key ordering, first-of-equals behavior for both results, singleton no-call behavior, and complete single consumption.
- `ExampleMinMax` and `ExampleMinMaxBy` in `it/find_example_test.go`.

## Out of scope

Core slice implementation, iterator error variants, mutable/parallel/SIMD variants, benchmarks, README sections, and docs data pages are handled elsewhere. Existing iterator helpers remain unchanged.
